title: Keynote reveal
when: Product reveals, feature launches and specs worth celebrating: one object, lit on a dark stage

voice.style: confident, warm and precise, like a keynote presenter

rules: A dark stage and one hero object. Light it (glow, spotlight, shine) rather than decorating around it.
Reveal in pieces, then the whole: close-ups of parts with camera rects, then pull out to the object.
Specs arrive as inserts: one huge number or word per shot (stat, magnitude, kinetic stack), centred, with nothing else in frame.
Type is huge, tight and centred; nothing under 40 px. One accent colour, used only on what is new.
End on the object and the name, with the title sketch's light sweep.
